_note: Visual directions. tokens are the only colours a design may use (lint flags others). radius is in canvas units (1u = short side / 100). pattern: dots | grid | stripes | rays | waves | clouds | none. texture: grain | paper | none. deco: sticker | line | soft | seal | none decides badges and frames. image_style feeds the image prompt. alias: an old id that now points at another direction (kept so saved specs and brand files still work).
